compiled_state.title: UPDATE: integrate coherence-walk.sh into validate.sh pipeline
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Task

Integrate `coherence-walk.sh` into `validate.sh` as a new optional gate, following the existing file-guard pattern used for `check-referential-integrity.sh` and `check-session-branch-invariant.sh`.

## Changes to validate.sh (UPDATE mode)

1. **LAUNCHED_CHECKS**: Add `coherence-walk` to the conditional guard block under `VALIDATE_SKIP_PLUGIN_CHECKS`:
   ```bash
   [ -f "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/coherence-walk.sh" ] && LAUNCHED_CHECKS="$LAUNCHED_CHECKS coherence-walk"
   ```

2. **Parallel launch block**: Add after referential-integrity and session-branch-invariant guards:
   ```bash
   if [ -f "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/coherence-walk.sh" ]; then
       (cd "$REPO_ROOT" && run_check "coherence-walk" "$TIMEOUT_SYNTAX" bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/coherence-walk.sh") &
   fi
   ```

3. **report_check** (non-verbose path): Add `report_check "coherence-walk" "coherence-walk" ...` line alongside other plugin checks.

4. **tally_check** (verbose path): Add matching `tally_check "coherence-walk" "coherence-walk"` line.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `validate.sh --ci` runs coherence-walk gate when script file exists
- [ ] Gate is skipped gracefully when `VALIDATE_SKIP_PLUGIN_CHECKS=1`
- [ ] Gate is skipped gracefully when `coherence-walk.sh` is absent (backward compat)
- [ ] ANTHROPIC_API_KEY absent → gate reports SKIP (not FAIL) so validate.sh can exit 0
- [ ] Existing validate.sh tests continue to pass (run tests/scripts/ suite)

## File Impact
- `plugins/dso/scripts/validate.sh` — modify (4 insertion points: LAUNCHED_CHECKS, parallel launch, report_check, tally_check)
- `tests/scripts/test-coherence-walk.sh` — may need additional integration test case for validate.sh skip behavior
